description: A control account read contact by contact, as an accountant audits it: for each receivable and payable account (or the one account_code names) and each contact, the balance brought forward from before the period, the debit and credit of the period, the closing balance, the number of lines of the period and the number still open today; the lines that name no contact in a row of their own, contact_id null. Debit minus credit, in the company currency; drafts are not in it. control gives, per account, its figures in the trial balance, the sum of its named contacts and the difference — the lines naming nobody — with ties_out true when that row is the difference to the cent. The lines of one row: general_ledger with account_code and contact_ids; one contact across its accounts: contact_statement.

account_code.description: One control account, by its code. Left out: every receivable and payable account of the chart.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

from.description: First day of the period. The balance brought forward is the one before it.

title: Subsidiary ledger
